model: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator
what_the_model_does: A tracked excavator in Volvo colours. The tracks roll when pushed (nothing drives them). The upper machine sits on a 60-tooth turntable and swings round. A hand pump, a T-piece and two air switches send air to air cylinders: one at the base of the arm (steps 22-26) and one at the elbow (step 90). The arm ends in a wide digger bucket. The rest is the cab, seat, counterweight, hood, yellow EC230 and ELECTRIC covers, roof with an orange rail and lamps, and orange hose fittings.
open_questions: Part identities in many sub-steps come from small icons (pins, connectors, thin beams). 'likely' parts may be a similar part with another number. parts_list.csv is derived from these readings and the whole-set inventory (pages 177-179), not an official list.
Hole numbers are mostly not countable from the pictures: they are marked ~ (best guess) or ? (not shown). 286 joins are ~ and 328 are ?.
Which switch drives which cylinder, and what the pump's second outlet feeds, is not shown clearly (steps 22-27, 110-111).
Pages 20, 25, 127, 141, 149, 153, 168 show a sub-build being attached with an arrow but no step number: they are covered in the note of the step before and in the next step.
Hoses (steps 106, 107, 110) are guesses from length bars that run off the page: 32L black, 25L grey, 13L grey, 18L black.
Steps 173-177 and 184-189 use small icons for black and dark grey connectors and ball parts; some identities may be wrong.
The grey 4274 pin stock (35) is used up by step 165; later grey pins are read as dark friction pins (61332) or 3673: step 173 is flagged.
Step 21/22 etc. keep some earlier readings; see needs_review in each step.

systems.name: Undercarriage frame
systems.real_machine: The lower frame of a crawler excavator that carries the tracks and the turntable.
systems.purpose: A stiff base: frame, side beams and pins that everything lower rests on.

systems.name: Tracks
systems.real_machine: The two crawler tracks (steel or rubber links on sprockets and rollers) that carry the machine.
systems.purpose: Two loops of 60 links on sprockets and rollers. Nothing drives them: they roll when the model is pushed.
systems.why_built_first: Built right after the frame so the model can stand.

systems.name: Swing turntable
systems.real_machine: The slewing ring that lets the whole upper machine spin on top of the tracks.
